messages:
Asha G.: Quick weird one — courier left a brown envelope by the bike racks at ~23:45 last night labeled 'D. Lin'. No one I know has that exact name. Did anyone pick it up?
Front Desk Bot: Late delivery scanned: DHL tracking 1234-5678-9012. Recipient: 'D. Lin'. Placed in secure bin (shelf C, slot 2). Signed by courier at 23:44.
Danny L.: Uh that might be for me? My badge shows 'Danny Li' (no n). I wasn't in office last night.
Priya S.: I found a package on my way out — big brown envelope with a charger sticker. Left it at my desk because I assumed it was for someone on floor 3.
Asha G.: If it's on Priya's desk can you drop it at front desk? We should avoid unlogged packages on desks.
Office Admin: Please drop any unidentified deliveries at the front desk. If you moved it, log it in #office-supplies with the tracking number.
Danny L.: Heading to the office now, I can swing by and check shelf C slot 2. If it's mine, I'll sign it out.
Front Desk Bot: Reminder: to sign out a late package, post message with tracking number and your name in #people-ops. Bin code 0421 expires at 6pm.
Priya S.: Mine was a different box — sorry for the confusion. I moved mine to the mail shelf B earlier.
Asha G.: No worries. Also unrelated: construction on 2nd floor next week. If you need quieter space, we can swap desks temporarily. DM me or use `/reserve` in #hotdesk to block a spot.
Danny L.: Can anyone swap me into a window seat Mon/Tues? My team needs a quiet spot for calls.
Office Admin: Window seat #3 is free Mon AM, window seat #4 is taken. I can update the hot-desk board if someone volunteers to swap.
Priya S.: I can take Danny's desk Tue afternoon. Posting on #hotdesk now.
Asha G.: Thanks! And reminder: if you pick up packages from the bike racks, please scan the tracking label into the tablet so front desk has a record.
